adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `TopicEmbed.import_remote` (uses `open(url).read` + `Readability::Document.new(..., tags:, attributes:)`) and wires it into two primary flows: `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` (`TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, @embed_url)`) and the Disqus importer (`TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`). The added specs cover `TopicEmbed.import` and high-level `TopicRetriever#retrieve` call gating, but there is no test exercising `import_remote` itself (no stubbing of `open`, no assertions about Readability title/content extraction, whitelist behavior, or encoding/parse failures). This is a specific, diff-grounded test gap for newly added nontrivial integration logic rather than a direct functional defect proven in the diff.
